cues.zh: 很多人都聊过“国际标准泡茶法”。
cues.en: Loads of people have talked about the International Standard Cup of Tea.

cues.zh: 网上有成百上千篇标题党文章在讲这个，
cues.en: And there are hundreds of clickbait articles describing it,

cues.zh: 要么吐槽这种泡茶方式大错特错，
cues.en: or ranting about how it's the wrong way to make tea,

cues.zh: 还有各种冗长的信息图表视频在讨论它。
cues.en: and there are lengthy infographics videos talking about it.

cues.zh: 但据我所知，
cues.en: But, as far as I can tell,

cues.zh: 之前还真没人在网上实操泡过一杯“标准茶”。
cues.en: no-one has actually made a Standard Cup of Tea for the internet before.

cues.zh: 原因主要有两点：
cues.en: And there are a couple of reasons for that:

cues.zh: 第一，你要么得花钱买一份标准文本，
cues.en: one, you have to either buy a copy of the standard

cues.zh: 要么得跑去订阅了该在线标准的图书馆，
cues.en: or visit a library that subscribes to the Standards online

cues.zh: 把里面的细节记下来；
cues.en: so you can write down the details,

cues.zh: 第二，它需要专业的设备。
cues.en: and two, it requires specialist equipment.

cues.zh: 英国大多数人泡茶，都是把茶包扔进马克杯里，
cues.en: Most people in Britain make their tea by putting a teabag in a mug

cues.zh: 然后直接倒开水冲泡。
cues.en: and then pouring boiling water on it.

cues.zh: 讲究点的话，就拿个预热好的茶壶，
cues.en: If you want to be fancy, then you take a pre-warmed teapot,

cues.zh: 放点散装茶叶进去，就像这种，
cues.en: and you put some loose-leaf tea in it, like this stuff,

cues.zh: 在壶里把茶泡好，
cues.en: and then you brew the tea in there,

cues.zh: 最后再拿滤网过滤，倒进杯子里。
cues.en: and then you pour the results through a strainer into a cup.

cues.zh: 这……这挺讲究的。
cues.en: It's... it's fancy.

cues.zh: 但标准，ISO 3103，对这些都没有要求。
cues.en: But the standard, ISO 3103, doesn't ask for any of that.

cues.zh: 它用的是一套大多数人听都没听过的设备：
cues.en: Instead, it uses a bit of equipment that most people won't even have heard of:

cues.zh: 也就是专业评茶套件。
cues.en: which is a Professional Tea Tasting Set.

cues.zh: 标准里用更技术性的语言描述了它，
cues.en: Now, the standard describes it in more technical terms,

cues.zh: 有图纸，还有结构、重量、尺寸和容积的要求，
cues.en: diagrams, and requirements of construction and weight and size and volume,

cues.zh: 好在我可以直接买一套符合标准的。
cues.en: but fortunately I could just buy a set that matched the standard.

cues.zh: 它的使用说明其实很简单：
cues.en: And the instructions for it are actually pretty simple:

cues.zh: 每100毫升水配2克茶叶，误差正负2%。
cues.en: you measure out 2g of tea per 100ml of water, plus or minus 2%.

cues.zh: 所以这里就是2.8克，误差正负0.05克，
cues.en: So for this, that means 2.8g, plus or minus .05g,

cues.zh: 这是我提前算好的，因为要精确到这个程度花了好久。
cues.en: which I worked out in advance because it took it ages to get it that precise.

cues.zh: 然后根据你要测试的内容，加入当地水或标准化水，
cues.en: And then you combine that with either local or standardised water depending on what you're testing,

cues.zh: 倒到这个杯子里锯齿的底部。
cues.en: by filling this little mug to the bottom of those serrations.

cues.zh: 而且你让它泡了六分钟，看起来有点长，但嘿，这是标准做法。
cues.en: Also, you let it steep for six minutes, which seems a bit long, but hey, that's the standard.

cues.zh: 六分钟一到，你就把所谓的“茶汤”从茶叶中分离出来
cues.en: Once your six minutes are up, you separate the 'liquor', as it's called, from the tea leaves

cues.zh: 把它通过这里的小锯齿滤口倒进这个杯子里。
cues.en: by pouring it through the little serrations here into this cup.

cues.zh: 看看我能不能做到……
cues.en: Let's see if I can do it...

cues.zh: 不行，我做不到。
cues.en: No, I can't.

cues.zh: 但也差不多够了。
cues.en: But close enough.

cues.zh: 他们说，如果要加奶，应该先倒奶，
cues.en: They say that if you're adding milk, you should put it in first,

cues.zh: 但这是绿茶，所以我就不掺和这个争论了。
cues.en: but this is green tea, so I'm not getting involved in that debate.

cues.zh: 从这里滤出去，大部分茶叶会留在杯里，
cues.en: You drain it through there, most of the leaves stay in the cup,

cues.zh: 滤完之后，你就可以观察茶叶了。
cues.en: and once it's drained, you can inspect the tea leaves.

cues.zh: 然后你不用传统的杯子喝，而是用碗喝。
cues.en: And then you drink it not from the traditional cup, but from the bowl.

cues.zh: 关于如何取样、如何报告，另有一套标准，ISO 1839。
cues.en: There is a separate standard, ISO 1839, on how you actually sample it, and what you report.

cues.zh: 尝起来，呃……
cues.en: And it tastes, er...

cues.zh: （啜饮）
cues.en: (slurps)

cues.zh: 味道还行。
cues.en: Tastes okay.

cues.zh: 就还行吧。
cues.en: It's just okay.

cues.zh: 因为这套标准本就不是为了泡出完美的一杯茶，
cues.en: Because the standard isn't meant to make the perfect cup of tea,

cues.zh: 也不是为了泡出最英式的一杯茶。
cues.en: or the most British cup of tea.

cues.zh: 每次“茶叶标准”这事儿在网上传开，
cues.en: Every time the fact that there's a Standard for Tea does the rounds of the internet,

cues.zh: 很多人都会误解它是规定性的，
cues.en: loads of people misunderstand it as being prescriptive,

cues.zh: 说什么“大家都该这么泡茶”，
cues.en: and saying "everyone should make their tea this way",

cues.zh: 但其实真不该这样。
cues.en: and they really shouldn't.

cues.zh: ISO 3103 的目的是泡出一杯还行、但可复现的茶。
cues.en: ISO 3103 is meant to make an okay but reproducible cup of tea.

cues.zh: 它给出了一套操作说明，这样不论你是谁、身在何处，
cues.en: It sets out instructions so that, whoever and wherever you are,

cues.zh: 你都能泡出和另一个时空里的人一样的一杯茶。
cues.en: you can create the same cup of tea as someone else in another time and place.

cues.zh: 在家喝普通茶？想怎么泡就怎么泡。
cues.en: For regular tea at home? Make it however you want.

cues.zh: 茶包往杯里一扔，牛奶先加后加都行。
cues.en: Stick a teabag in a mug, put the milk in first or last.

cues.zh: 想用精致瓷器也随你。
cues.en: Use fancy china if you want.

cues.zh: 提前几天把茶泡好，然后再用微波炉加热。
cues.en: Make your tea days in advance and then warm it up again in the microwave.

cues.zh: 别……别那么做。
cues.en: Don't... don't do that.

cues.zh: 但这不重要。
cues.en: But it doesn't matter.

cues.zh: 没有完美的茶，只有适合你的茶。
cues.en: There is no perfect cup of tea: there's only the right one for you.

cues.zh: 这杯？这不算完美，绝对不算完美，
cues.en: This here? This isn't perfect, it definitely isn't perfect,

cues.zh: 但据我所知，
cues.en: but as far as I can tell,

cues.zh: 这是互联网上第一杯国际标准茶。
cues.en: this is the first International Standard Cup of Tea on the internet.

cues.zh: （啜饮）
cues.en: (slurps)

cues.zh: 其实我并不喜欢喝茶。
cues.en: I don't actually like tea.
